runs.statement: The 55% most confident of the 15813 windows counted on this map (8697 windows) are wrong at most 10% of the time; this statement fails on at most 10% of samples like the recorded one (target rule, 200 random labels; the exact upper bound on the zone's error rate at that level is 9.3%). 571 of the map's 16384 windows are left out as no-data, and nothing here describes them. Alpha, delta and the rule were fixed with the draw, before any label. It is about the zone's windows of 1 px taken together, not each pixel; outside the zone nothing is certified, which does not mean wrong; it assumes the reviewer's labels are right and that the sample was drawn once; and delta counts every sample, those that certify nothing included, so among samples that certify a zone more than delta can be wrong.
